test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Those kids always watch cartoon movies.

options.text: Cartoon movies are watched by those kids always.
Cartoon movies are watching by those kids always.
Cartoon movies were watched by those kids always.
Cartoon movies watched by those kids always.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The type of the sentence is **declarative**, and the tense of the given sentence is **simple present**.
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **"Those kids"** and the object is **"cartoon movies."**
 
• The format of active voice for present simple tense is: **Subject + V1 (base form of the verb) + object.**
 
• The format of passive voice for present simple tense is: **Subject (Objective case) + are + V3 (past participle form of the verb) + by + Object (Subjective case).**
 
• **Example**: 
 
 
• "The gardener waters the plants daily." (Active Voice) 
 
• "The plants are watered by the gardener daily." (Passive Voice)
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is- *“Cartoon movies are watched by those kids always.”***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 ("Cartoon movies are watching by those kids always.")** uses an incorrect verb form; the passive voice requires the past participle form of the verb, not the gerund (-ing) form.
 
• **Option 3 ("Cartoon movies were watched by those kids always.") **shifts the sentence into the past tense, which does not accurately convey the present, ongoing action described in the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4 ("Cartoon movies watched by those kids always.")** lacks the auxiliary verb needed for constructing the passive voice correctly.
